name: Szomolya (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szomolya: a blue shield with a bunch of grapes and a column, with a cherry crest and green mantling, above a scroll inscribed SZOMOLYA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szomolya arms with crest, mantling and scroll
